items.title: Emile Barnes and Paul Barnes Interview, 1959-10-01
items.q: I played the Capitol on the Capitol and with Papa Solis there... I left the band and went back with Papa Solis there and band and stayed there until 27.

ctx.x: In those days then when the Island Queen, that was a rival line, did they have two dances? I just kind of. I mean two boats here at the same time?

I just don't remember if they had two at the same time. But I know what we played, I played the Capitol on the Capitol and with Papa Solis there. Not regular, we played jobs on the Capitol. But I did play regular on the Island Queen in Sidney. And that was around 1925. But I didn't play it, stayed there too long. I left the band and went back with Papa Solis there and band and stayed there until 27.
I didn't know that, that bothers me about that boat being here. Was that winter time or summer?
